en: Notifications can open a card or postpone its reminder by three days; edits from another device are surfaced immediately.
Reminder Center, usage history and projections, expiry calendar, and iCal export.
Batch actions, saved views, activity history, and card-version restore.
JSON / CSV / Excel transfer, phone / eSIM QR scanning, and screenshot-assisted usage capture.
PWA, widgets, deep links, Trip Mode, templates, sharing, and device security work together.
